title: Friends Who Live Far Away
sentences: My closest friend moved to another country almost three years ago now.
At first we spoke almost every week.
Then the calls became monthly, and after that they became rarer still.
Neither of us had decided to speak less often; it simply happened that way.
The time difference between us makes a casual conversation surprisingly difficult.
By the time she finishes work, I am asleep.
We now write each other long messages instead, which suits both of us better.
She tells me things in writing that I am sure she would never say aloud.
In the spring I finally saw her, for the first time since she moved away.
Within an hour it felt as though no time at all had passed between us.
